# Enterprise Architecture & Governance

The **EA / platform governance** view: inventory, landing-zone and policy compliance, tagging, network posture, RBAC, resilience coverage, and architecture drift - driven by Azure Resource Graph across the tenant.

> **SRE Agent at the center.** This page is an operating surface for both humans and the SRE Agent. Set the **Subscriptions** and **Log Analytics workspace** parameters, then act on the Top 10 recommendations below.

parameters.name: LogAnalyticsWorkspaceId
parameters.label: Log Analytics workspace
parameters.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' | project value = id, label = name, selected = false | order by label asc

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.label: Environment

content.json:
## Governance at a glance

Tenant policy-compliance posture and the compliant vs non-compliant split.

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| extend cs = tostring(properties.complianceState)
| summarize C = countif(cs == 'Compliant'), Total = count()
| extend Pct = iff(Total > 0, round(100.0*C/Total, 1), 100.0)
| extend Posture = case(Pct < 60, 'CRITICAL', Pct < 80, 'DEGRADED', Pct < 95, 'ELEVATED', 'HEALTHY')
| project Posture, ['Compliance %'] = Pct
content.title: Compliance posture

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| summarize Count = count() by State = tostring(properties.complianceState)
| order by Count desc
content.title: Policy compliance mix

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| summarize States = count() by State = tostring(properties.complianceState)
| order by States desc
content.title: Compliance counts

content.json:
## Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

Prioritized, auditable actions the **SRE Agent** has produced for this page, ranked by `RecommendationScore`. Each row is evidence-backed and carries its agent action type, approval requirement, and lifecycle status.

- **Approval required = true** -> the agent will *not* act without human sign-off (always true for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes).
- Use the **Evidence / Incident / PR / Runbook** links to drill into the supporting data.
- Source table: `SREAgentRecommendations_CL`. If empty, no active recommendations exist for this page, or the workspace parameter is not yet set - see *Configuration* in the README.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == "Enterprise Architecture & Governance" and WorkbookPage == "Enterprise Architecture & Governance"
| where Status in ("New","Pending approval","Approved","In progress","Failed")
| where isnull(ExpiresOn) or ExpiresOn > now()
| where "{Severity}" == "All" or "{Severity}" == "" or Severity == "{Severity}"
| where "{BusinessCriticality}" == "All" or "{BusinessCriticality}" == "" or BusinessCriticality == "{BusinessCriticality}"
| where "{OwnerTeam}" == "*" or "{OwnerTeam}" == "" or OwnerTeam =~ "{OwnerTeam}"
| where "{RecommendationStatus}" in ("Active","All","") or Status == "{RecommendationStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| order by RecommendationScore desc, Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
| take 10
| project
    Rank,
    Severity,
    Recommendation = RecommendationText,
    Scope = AffectedScope,
    OwnerTeam,
    Confidence = ConfidenceScore,
    ['Agent action'] = AgentActionType,
    ['Approval required'] = ApprovalRequired,
    Status,
    ['Last updated'] = LastUpdated,
    Evidence = EvidenceLinks,
    Runbook = RelatedWorkItem,
    Incident = RelatedIncidentId,
    PR = RelatedPullRequest,
    RecommendationId
content.title: Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

content.json:
## Management group & subscription inventory

The account topology the rest of the suite is scoped against.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| project Subscription = name, state = tostring(properties.state)
| order by Subscription asc
content.title: Subscriptions

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.management/managementgroups'
| project name, displayName = tostring(properties.displayName)
| order by displayName asc
content.title: Management groups

content.json:
## Resource inventory

What exists, by type, region, and environment tag. The denominator for every coverage and compliance metric.

content.query:
resources
| summarize Count = count() by type
| order by Count desc
| take 50
content.title: Resources by type

content.query:
resources
| extend env = tostring(tags['Environment'])
| summarize Count = count() by location, env
| order by Count desc
content.title: Resources by region & environment

content.json:
## Policy & landing-zone compliance

Azure Policy compliance state across the tenant. Non-compliance is the agent's governance backlog.

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| extend state = tostring(properties.complianceState)
| summarize Count = count() by state
| order by Count desc
content.title: Policy compliance summary

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| where tostring(properties.complianceState) == 'NonCompliant'
| summarize NonCompliant = count() by policyDefinition = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionName)
| order by NonCompliant desc
| take 25
content.title: Top non-compliant policies

content.json:
## Tag compliance

Resources missing governance-critical tags (Owner, Environment, CostCenter). Drives ownership and cost-allocation gaps elsewhere in the suite.

content.query:
resources
| extend owner = tostring(tags['Owner']), env = tostring(tags['Environment']), cc = tostring(tags['CostCenter'])
| extend MissingOwner = isempty(owner), MissingEnv = isempty(env), MissingCostCenter = isempty(cc)
| where MissingOwner or MissingEnv or MissingCostCenter
| summarize Count = count() by type
| order by Count desc
| take 50
content.title: Missing required tags

content.json:
## Network exposure & private endpoints

Public-exposure posture and private-endpoint adoption. Overlaps with Security & Identity; here it is an architecture-standard check.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses'
| extend assoc = isnotempty(tostring(properties.ipConfiguration.id))
| summarize Total = count(), Associated = countif(assoc) by location
| order by Total desc
content.title: Public IP addresses

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints'
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize PrivateEndpoints = count() by location, Subscription
| order by PrivateEndpoints desc
content.title: Private endpoint adoption

## RBAC posture

Role-assignment surface, with emphasis on broad/privileged grants. Detailed risky-assignment analysis lives in Security & Identity.

content.query:
authorizationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments'
| extend roleId = tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId)
| summarize Assignments = count() by roleId
| order by Assignments desc
| take 25
content.title: Role assignments by role

## Resilience & Advisor

Zone-redundancy and backup/DR coverage, plus Azure Advisor's reliability and operational-excellence recommendations.

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| extend category = tostring(properties.category), impact = tostring(properties.impact)
| summarize Count = count() by category, impact
| order by Count desc
content.title: Advisor recommendations by category

### Operating model (safe-update)
Live data on this page refreshes automatically. Changes to the **workbook definition** follow the suite's safe-update model:

| Change | How it happens |
| --- | --- |
| Live data refresh | Automatic |
| Low-risk metadata (titles, descriptions, layout) | Agent may auto-apply, versioned |
| Medium/high-risk panel or query changes | Pull request + human approval |
| SLO, alert, remediation, health-scoring, access scope, panel deletion | **Mandatory approval** - agent records a recommendation only |

Every change is versioned, validated, auditable, and reversible. See `docs/operating-model.md`.
